title: On the Limits of Execution Traces for Repairing Assertion Failures in LLM-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.09212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Iterative repair returns a failed program's error to a large language model (LLM) and asks it to fix it. After iterative repair, the remaining failures are mostly assertion failures: with four Qwen2.5 models, they make up 79% of residual failures on BigCodeBench, all on HumanEval and 93% on LiveCodeBench. We argue, through an information view of the feedback, that an assertion failure says little about where the fault lies. We propose Breakpoint Debugging (BPD), which returns the failed program annotated inline with its variables' runtime values. We take the tasks that iterative repair failed to fix with five repair attempts and compare two ways of spending five further generations on them: BPD, and resampling. On BigCodeBench, BPD repairs 26.7% of these tasks against 22.4%, and its advantage grows with model size. translated_title: 《论执行轨迹在修复大语言模型生成代码断言失败方面的局限性》
translated_abstract: 迭代修复将失败程序的错误信息返回给大语言模型（LLM），并要求其进行修复。经过迭代修复后，剩余的失败大多是断言失败：在使用四个Qwen2.5模型的实验中，断言失败在BigCodeBench上占剩余失败的79%，在HumanEval上占全部失败，在LiveCodeBench上占93%。我们通过一种信息视角对反馈进行分析，论证了断言失败几乎无法说明故障究竟位于何处。我们提出断点调试，该方法将失败程序连同其变量运行时值的内联注释一并返回给模型。我们选取了迭代修复在五次修复尝试后仍未能修复的任务，并比较两种消耗五次额外生成机会的方式：BPD与重采样。在BigCodeBench上，BPD修复了其中26.7%的任务，而重采样为22.4%，且BPD的优势随模型规模增大而增长。在HumanEval上，BPD略优于重采样，而在LiveCodeBench上，重新采样修复得更多（6.5%对……
tldr: 提出断点调试（BPD）方法，通过在失败程序中内联标注变量的运行时值，为大语言模型提供比断言错误信息更丰富的反馈，实验表明其在修复迭代修复遗留的断言失败方面总体优于简单重采样，但这一优势随基准不同而有所差异，揭示了执行轨迹反馈的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Breakpoint Debugging (BPD), which annotates failed LLM-generated code inline with runtime variable values, showing that such richer execution feedback repairs residual assertion failures better than plain resampling on BigCodeBench, though its advantage varies across benchmarks and remains limited.
